receipt.equivalence_review: Initial role-filter error was followed by a successful complete 16-block query; both eligible input blocks require fixed 5 V, incompatible with the mandatory 12 V N1 function/interface/source. Typed CHECK_FAILED at functions.power_input replays from the original pinned brief. No invented records or treatment of query errors as catalog absence.

refusal.reason: The complete block search returned exactly two power.input blocks: block:usb-c-5v-sink and block:usb-c-usb2-sink, both AGENT_VERIFIED. Each requires output_voltage with a fixed contract of 5 V. The mandatory power_input function requires 12 V, reinforced by the input interface and input_12v power source, and explicitly disallows a 5 V USB substitution. Thus the required operating point conflicts with every eligible power.input block; changing the contract or inventing another block would violate the closed-world requirement.
